title: COMMUNITY-CROSS-INSTRUCT: Unsupervised Instruction Generation for Aligning Large Language Models to Online Communities

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the ideological alignment of fine-tuned language models by administering automatically generated multiple-choice survey questions based on discussions from various political subreddits (e.g., r/Liberal, r/Conservative).

Evaluating the alignment of fine-tuned language models with specific lifestyle attitudes by administering automatically generated multiple-choice survey questions based on discussions from diet and weight-loss subreddits (e.g., r/keto, r/EDAnonymous).
